decisions.executionNote: Raise left arm into elbow-up approach, beginning downward wrist rotation toward the left tube; right arm stays home.
Advance above the left tube while aligning the open jaws with its visible axis; approach remains high before final descent.
Lower open left jaws around the tube body, making a small image-based centering correction.
Refine alignment toward the tube cap and close on the body; retention still needs a lift check.
Lift the left tube clear with the gripper closed and check that it follows before rotating upright.
Tube follows the lift. Rotate it toward upright while transporting toward the left rack slot, maintaining clearance.
Finish upright rotation above the left side of the rack; approach insertion height only after checking alignment.
Visually align the upright tube over a left-front large rack hole and descend cautiously, keeping the grasp closed.
Continue the first insertion slowly with a small leftward alignment correction; keep the tube held until depth is checked.
Corrected invalid row; lift the retained tube slightly and align toward the adjacent visible large rack opening.
Lower into the large opening now visible directly beneath the tube tip, maintaining closed jaws.
Seat the first tube another small increment into the aligned large hole; watch for contact or slipping before release.
Contact suggests the tip is on the rim. Unload upward and shift toward the visible hole center instead of forcing deeper.
Center the tip laterally over the visible opening, make a short seating descent, and release to observe whether the rack supports it.
Withdraw the fully open left gripper and inspect whether the released tube remains upright in the rack.
Clear the rack with the open left arm while beginning an elbow-up approach to the inner right tube; inspect the released tube from the unobstructed head view.
The released tube remains supported in the rack. Return the left arm while moving the open right gripper above the nearer right-side tube.
Replan with smaller increments after the guard. Finish returning the left arm and lower the open right jaws toward the inner tube's body.
Center the right grasp slightly toward the cap, then close on the tube body while the left arm settles at home.
Lift the second tube away from the table with the right gripper closed, leaving the left arm at home.
The second tube follows the lift. Begin rotating it upright and carrying it toward the right side of the rack at safe clearance.
Continue upright rotation and bring the second tube above a free right-side rack opening without lowering into the plate yet.
Finish vertical alignment of the second tube and lower toward the right-front large opening, keeping clearance for a visual check.
Lower the upright second tube toward its slot, checking wrist alignment before the final seating and release.
Continue a slow vertical seating motion for the second tube, watching for rim contact before opening.
Make a small rearward centering adjustment above the second slot, then reseat gently rather than push against the rim.
Release the second tube at the opening and withdraw with open jaws to inspect whether it is seated and upright.
The second tube remains supported after release. Clear the rack and begin the right-arm approach to the remaining tube with the gripper open.
Resume from the observed pose with smaller wrist and translation increments after the continuity guard.
Continue the open right-arm approach toward the remaining tube, rotating downward while maintaining table clearance.
Finish the downward wrist orientation and approach the remaining tube with open jaws, staying in the right workspace.
Refine the open right-jaw position and yaw from the wrist view so the last tube is centered before closing.
Center around the last tube's body and close the right gripper; the next lift will verify retention.
Lift the last tube clear of the table with closed jaws and verify it remains held before upright transport.
Last tube is retained. Begin upright rotation and transport toward the free middle slot, keeping the right arm above the table.
Continue carrying the retained tube toward the middle opening while rotating upright; keep it above the rack and existing tubes.
Finish bringing the held tube upright above the free middle opening, keeping clearance from the two released tubes.
Align the upright third tube over the middle large opening and begin the insertion descent with the jaws closed.
Lower the third tube vertically into the middle opening, watching for rim contact and maintaining the closed grasp.
The tip appears to be on the middle slot's rim. Lift slightly and recenter rearward and right before another gentle descent.
Seat the recentered third tube slowly to insertion depth, keeping its orientation fixed and the jaws closed.
Recenter the third tube over the large opening visible beside its tip, reseat briefly, and open the gripper to check support.
Withdraw the open right gripper to inspect all three tubes without hand occlusion and check seating and uprightness.
The middle tube is visibly leaning after release. Reapproach it with open jaws for a corrective grasp rather than declaring completion.
Center the open right jaws around the leaning middle tube's upper body for a controlled corrective grasp.
Close on the middle tube's body and begin a small lift to test retention before correcting its lean.
Lift the regrasped middle tube out of its slot and begin correcting its forward lean while compensating wrist height for clearance.
After the continuity stop, use smaller rotation and height increments to straighten the retained middle tube without dragging its tip.
Apply a smaller final lean correction while approximately holding the tube's grasp point stationary above the rack.
Lower the straightened middle tube toward the opening while keeping its corrected orientation and a closed grasp.
The tip appears near the rack's front edge. Shift the retained tube farther over the plate before further lowering.
The tip is above a small aperture; lift and shift toward the adjacent large opening visible on its right, then approach gently.
